name: druva-mcp-server
title: Druva
summary: Manage backups, audit logs, and environment metrics across the Druva Resilience Cloud using natural language.
description: The official Druva MCP Server connects AI agents to the Druva Resilience Cloud over a secure remote HTTP connection. Agents can discover Druva capabilities as skills, fetch data from your environment, and perform non-destructive actions to manage backup and data protection. Use it to query backup and recovery status across endpoints, SaaS apps, and cloud workloads. Also, review audit logs, and monitor environment metrics through natural language.

externalDocumentation.title: Complete Guide to Druva MCP Server

useCases.name: Backup & Recovery Insights
useCases.description: Query backup coverage, job outcomes, and recovery status across endpoints, Microsoft 365, and cloud workloads using natural language.

useCases.name: Environment Management
useCases.description: Perform non-destructive management actions in your Druva environment via read and write skills; the server cannot delete configurations or backup data.

useCases.name: Audit & Compliance
useCases.description: Review audit logs and activity across the Druva Resilience Cloud to support governance, compliance, and investigation workflows.

useCases.name: Monitoring & Reporting
useCases.description: Monitor environment metrics such as protection health and storage consumption, and surface reporting insights on demand.
